items.action: None, unless a loading button with an `icon` must keep hiding its label behind a centred spinner: bind `loadingMode="replace"` on that button.
items.appliesWhen: A `ds-button` that sets both `icon` and `loading`. A button without `icon` renders as before, and `ds-icon-button` has no loading state.
items.verify: A loading `ds-button` with an `icon` shows its label with a spinner in the icon's place, unless it binds `loadingMode="replace"`.

items.action: None, unless a test or a selector finds the date input by the `textbox` role: query the `combobox` role instead.
items.appliesWhen: A test, a selector or a template that targets the `ds-date-picker` text input by role.
items.verify: The `ds-date-picker` text input reports `role="combobox"` and still parses a typed date.

informational.text: New `[dsPopoverTrigger]` directive (`DsPopoverTrigger`, exported with `PopoverComponent`) opens a `ds-popover` from a button and sets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on its inner `<button>`; `ds-popover` gains `panelId` and `holdsMenu`.
informational.verify: A `ds-icon-button` with `[dsPopoverTrigger]` around a `ds-menu` popover: Enter opens the menu, the inner button reads aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded="true", and Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.

informational.text: Now in a single `ds-time-picker` sets the current time and closes the panel; a range panel stays open until Done.
informational.verify: Open a single ds-time-picker, press Now: the field shows the current time and the panel is closed.

informational.text: `--ds-menu-gap` defaults to `0px` instead of `var(--space-0-5)`, so `ds-menu` rows touch. To restore the gap, set `--ds-menu-gap: var(--space-0-5)` on the menu or a parent.
informational.verify: Open any ds-menu: there is no strip between rows, and hovering down the list keeps one row filled at every pointer position.
